subject: Ogre Mage
picture: A huge ogre mage stands in a stone ritual chamber and holds a simple wooden staff upright in one hand. One head, one torso, two arms, two hands, two legs, two feet. Small tusks, thick belly, hide wrap, a few large beads on the staff. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, a simple altar as big shapes, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
